name: – Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu – § 30 – Am 7
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: 30. Calls on the Commission and the Member States to promote measures to reduce and prevent harmful alcohol consumption, and to present a revised EU alcohol strategy, including a European zero alcohol consumption strategy for minors, accompanied, where appropriate, by legislative proposals in line with Article 168 TFEU and respecting the principle of subsidiarity; urges the Member States to devise awareness-raising initiatives geared especially towards minors with a view to providing clear information about harmful alcohol consumption, so as to promote informed choices and help people better understand its effects on their health;
